title: The developer tools that will define the next decade

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if I told you the next big leap in coding is already here?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI-powered dev tools are changing how we build software — and fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re platforms like GitHub Copilot, but even smarter and faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: These tools can write full functions from natural language prompts.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers across all industries are adopting them at record speeds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just efficiency — it’s a revolution in how we create tech.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know what’s next? Follow me for the inside scoop.
